stories.title: The Red Sled
lines: Fred got a red sled.
He went up the hilltop with Stan.
The sled slid fast.
Stan fell in the soft grass.
"That was fun!" he yells.
Then they ran up the hill.

stories.title: Six Frogs
lines: Six frogs sat on a log.
They swim in the pond.
A big fish snaps at them.
The frogs jump up fast.
Stan claps from the bank.
"You win!" he yells.

stories.title: The Lost Sock
lines: Jen lost a red sock.
She digs in the desk and bed.
Rex the dog runs to the bag.
He drops a damp sock at Jen.
"Rex! You got it!" she yells.
Jen pets him and hugs Rex.

stories.title: Brad and the Twin Dogs
lines: Brad has twin dogs.
They jump and yelp in the grass.
A dog grabs a stick.
The next dog tugs the strap.
Brad claps his hands.
"Stop, dogs!" he said.
Then the dogs sit and rest.

stories.title: The Picnic on the Hill
lines: Mom packs a picnic.
Ham, milk and a fig go in.
Tom and Kim run up the hill.
They sit on a flat rock.
A bug sits on the ham.
Kim gets it off with a twig.
Then they munch the snack.

stories.title: The Drum in the Trunk
lines: Stan digs in a trunk.
He gets a drum and a stick.
Stan hits the drum. Bang!
Mom and Dad grin.
"That is a big bang," said Mom.
Fran claps from the steps.
They sing a long song.

stories.title: The Ducks at the Pond
lines: Six ducks swim in the pond.
Meg had a bag.
In it is a bun.
She rips the bun up.
The ducks quack and rush up.
A big duck honks at Meg.
"Stop that!" she said with a grin.
Then the ducks swim off.

stories.title: Fran and the Lost Flag
lines: Fran had a red flag.
A big gust got it.
It went up and up.
It stuck in a twig.
Glen gets a long stick.
He tugs the flag off the twig.
Fran hugs Glen.
They run back to the tent.

stories.title: The Skunk in the Sandbox
lines: Nick ran to the sandbox.
A skunk sat in it.
"Stop!" said Dad. "Do not run up."
The skunk digs and sniffs.
It got a bug and a nut.
Then it went past the steps.
Nick and Dad went in.
They munch a snack and grin.

stories.title: The Bench at the Bus Stop
lines: Gus sits on a bench.
He is at the bus stop.
A man drops his hat.
The hat fell in the dust.
Gus picks it up and runs.
"Thank you!" said the man.
Then the bus honks.
Gus hops up the steps.
Gus and the man get on.

stories.title: The Crab and the Clam
lines: A crab sat on the sand.
A clam was next to him.
"Can you swim?" said the crab.
"I do not swim," said the clam.
The crab claps his legs.
Then a big fish swam up.
The clam shut fast.
The crab hid in the sand.
The fish went past them.

stories.title: The Stuck Truck
lines: Dad had a red truck.
It got stuck in the mud.
Liz and Tim dig.
They put a flat rock in.
Dad steps on the gas.
The truck spins and spins.
Then it gets up the bank.
Liz claps and Tim yells.
Then they get in and go.

stories.title: The Gift in the Box
lines: Meg gets a gift from Jan.
It is a big box.
In it is a silk vest.
Meg has it on fast.
"I am glad," she said.
Jan and Meg run off to camp.

stories.title: The Chimp and the Plum
lines: A chimp sat on a big rock.
He had a fresh plum.
A bug fell on it.
The chimp did not munch it.
He drops the plum in the grass.
Then he gets a fig.

stories.title: Ben and the Clock
lines: The clock on the desk stops.
Ben picks it up.
Dad gets a thin pin.
He hits the back of it.
Tick, tick! The clock is on.
Ben sets it on the shelf.

stories.title: The Lamp and the Moth
lines: A moth hits the lamp.
Bang, bang! It went on and on.
Tim gets a big glass cup.
He gets the moth in the cup.
Then he steps past the desk.
He lets the moth go.
"Off you go," said Tim.

stories.title: Jack and the Chest
lines: Jack dug up a chest.
It had a lock of rust.
He hits it with a brick.
The lid went up.
In it are ten bells.
Jack rings them at the camp.
Kim and Bess run up fast.

stories.title: The Twin Crabs
lines: Fran and Stan sat in the sand.
Twin crabs ran past them.
"Do not grab them," said Fran.
The crabs dig in fast.
Stan drops a bit of ham.
The crabs snap it up.
Then they swim off.

stories.title: The Frog in the Tub
lines: Kim ran a bath.
A frog hops in the tub.
The frog kicks and spins.
Kim yells, "Mom! A wet frog!"
Mom gets a big red cup.
She picks the frog up in it.
They let it go in the grass.
Then Kim has a bath.

stories.title: The Bug Hunt
lines: Nick and Jill went on a hunt.
They had a list and a net.
Bugs sat in the damp grass.
Jill gets a red bug.
Nick has a fat slug.
They put them in a box.
Then they let them go.
"Bugs must go back," said Jill.

stories.title: The Zigzag Path
lines: A path went up the hilltop.
It did zigzag past the rocks.
Fred and Meg step up it.
Meg drops a fig at the top.
A chipmunk grabs it fast.
"Stop!" yells Meg.
The chipmunk runs in the grass.
Fred and Meg grin and go on.

stories.title: Bess and the Dress
lines: Bess had a fresh dress.
It was red and pink.
She went to the pond with Jen.
Jen fell in the mud.
Mud got on the dress.
Bess did not get mad.
"Mud will drip off," she said.
Mom got a brush and a tub.
Then Bess and Jen swim.

stories.title: The Camp at Dusk
lines: Dad set up a tent.
Tom and Liz dig a pit.
At dusk the camp was still.
A bug did buzz past the tent.
Liz held a lamp up.
Tom fed the dog a snack.
They sang and had a chat.
Then Dad put the lamp off.
They rest in the soft grass.

stories.title: The Best Trick
lines: Glen can do a trick.
He spins a cup on a stick.
Stan claps and claps.
Then Glen drops it.
The cup did not crash.
"That was the best trick," said Stan.
Glen picks it up.
He spins it up on his hand.
They run off to lunch.

stories.title: The Elf and the Bells
lines: An elf sat on a rock.
He had ten bells in a bag.
The elf rings them.
The bells sing in the mist.
Kids run up the hill fast.
The elf hands a bell to Jill.

stories.title: Tom and the Big Belt
lines: Tom got a belt from Dad.
It was a big belt.
It slips off him.
Mom cut a bit off.
Then she sets it on him.
Tom hugs Mom and runs off.

stories.title: The Fox Mask
lines: Jan has a mask.
It is a fox mask.
She hid in the shed.
Ben went past and got a shock.
"It is just Jan!" he yells.
They run to the swing.

stories.title: The Swing at the Camp
lines: A swing hung at the camp.
Kim hops on it.
Dad can lift Kim up.
Up she went, up and up.
Kim kicks and yells.
Then Tom hops on next.
They swing in the sun.

stories.title: The Frost on the Steps
lines: Frost was on the steps.
Fred slid and fell.
He did not yell.
Mom got a bag of sand.
She drops it on the steps.
Fred steps up and can grip it.
"That is best," he said.

stories.title: The Pigs and the Nuts
lines: Ten pigs sat in the mud.
They flop and grunt.
Stan had a bag of nuts.
The pigs run up fast.
They munch the nuts up.
A pig licks his hand.
Stan claps and pets the pig.

stories.title: The Nest on the Cliff
lines: Up on a cliff was a nest.
In it sat a chick.
The chick has thin wings.
It can flap them.
Jen and Rick stand and grin.
"It will jump," said Rick.
The chick hops off the cliff.
Up it went, up and up!

stories.title: The Pots and the Pan
lines: Mom set pots on the shelf.
Ted got a pan and a stick.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
"That is a band," said Dad.
Dad gets a tin lid.
They bang and sing a song.
Mom stops and claps.
Then they put the pots back.

stories.title: The Lost Map
lines: Jack had a map of the camp.
The map fell in the grass.
Jack and Fran hunt and hunt.
They lift up a big rock.
Bess yells, "It is in the mud!"
Jack grabs the damp map.
He sets it in the sun.
Then they run back to camp.

stories.title: The Cat and the String
lines: Liz had a long red string.
She held it up.
The cat hops at it.
It grabs the string fast.
Jen claps from the bed.
The cat jumps and spins.
Then the string got in a lump.
Liz sits and can mend it.
The cat naps on the rug.

stories.title: The Raft on the Pond
lines: Dad and Bob had a raft.
They put it in the pond.
Bob steps on it fast.
The raft did not sink.
Dad hands him a stick.
Bob digs it in the mud.
The raft went past the dock.
A duck swam with them.
"That was the best trip," said Bob.

stories.title: The Sand Hill
lines: Six kids sat in the sandbox.
They dig a big sand hill.
Jill packs it with flat hands.
Tim digs a pond next to it.
A dog runs up the hill.
The sand hill fell in.
The kids did not get mad.
They pat the sand up.
Then the dog naps in it.

stories.title: The Sunset on the Hill
lines: Ben and Jen went up the hill.
The sun sank in the west.
Red and pink fill the pond.
"That is the best sunset," said Jen.
Bugs sing in the grass.
Then they run back to the tent.

stories.title: The Cat and the Catnip
lines: Kim has a bag of catnip.
She fills a sock with it.
The cat sniffs the sock.
It grabs it and spins.
Kim claps. The dog runs in.
Then the cat naps on the bed.

stories.title: Ten Hens
lines: Ten hens sat in a pen.
Gus fills the pans with nuts.
The hens run up and peck.
Six hens hop on a log.
Gus gets a red hen.
He pets it. Then he runs in.

stories.title: The Ships in the Tub
lines: Tim has ten ships.
They are red, tan and pink.
He sets them in the bathtub.
The ships bob and spin.
Tim puffs at them.
Six ships tip and sink.
"My ships must not sink!" he yells.

stories.title: The Laptop and the Cat
lines: Dad sits at his laptop.
The cat hops up on it.
It sits on his thin hands.
"Not on the laptop!" said Dad.
The cat winks and naps.
Dad can lift the cat off.
Then he pets it on his lap.

stories.title: Lunch at the Bench
lines: Meg sat on a bench.
She had a bun and a plum.
A gust got the napkin.
Up went the napkin, past the shed.
Meg runs and jumps at it.
She grabs it fast.
Then she sits and has lunch.

stories.title: The Insect on the Desk
lines: An insect sat on the desk.
It had six legs and thin wings.
Jill gets a big cup.
She sets the cup on it.
The insect did buzz in it.
Jill steps to the deck.
She lets it go.
It zips up and off.

stories.title: Jill Fills the Cups
lines: Jill sets six cups on the mat.
She fills them with milk.
The dog hits the mat.
Milk spills on the rug!
Jill gets a big rag.
She rubs and rubs.
Mom can help Jill rub it.
Then they fill the cups up.

stories.title: Things in the Trunk
lines: Bess got a big trunk.
Things fell on the rug.
A silk hat and ten pens.
A doll with no legs.
Bess and Nell stand and grin.
"Kings had such things," said Nell.
Bess sets the hat on Nell.
Nell winks and hugs Bess.

stories.title: The Run Up the Hill
lines: The kids run up the hill.
Stan and Fran are fast.
Glen trips on a stick.
Stan stops and can help him.
They run up next to Fran.
Fran wins the run!
She hugs Stan and Glen.
"That was fun," said Glen.
They sit in the grass and rest.

stories.title: The Big Mess in the Shed
lines: The shed was a big mess.
Pots, maps and socks sat in it.
Dad and Ted stand and think.
"Let us pick things up," said Dad.
Ted packs the socks in a box.
Dad sets the pots on a shelf.
The maps go in a bin.
At dusk the shed is fresh.
They sit on the steps and rest.

stories.title: The Twin Tents
lines: Fran and Brad set up twin tents.
Brad picks the flat spot.
Fran picks the top of the bank.
At dusk a big gust hits.
The tent on the bank fell in.
Brad yells, "Get in with us!"
Fran runs to his tent fast.
They sit and munch a snack.
Then they nod off and rest.

stories.title: The Stack of Cups
lines: Tom sets up a stack of cups.
The stack got big.
Meg gets a twig.
She hits the stack.
Smash! The cups drop on the rug.
Tom and Meg stack them up.

stories.title: The Slip on the Deck
lines: Rick ran on the wet deck.
He slips and fell.
His mug spills on the step.
Dad rubs the deck with a rag.
"Do not run on it," said Dad.
Rick nods and steps back in.

stories.title: The Snug Den
lines: Liz and Max dig a den.
They put moss in it.
It is snug and dim.
Max sets a lamp on a rock.
A bug sniffs at the moss.
"This is the best den," said Liz.

stories.title: The Sled Plan
lines: Jack and Kim had a plan.
They will fix the red sled.
Kim gets a bit of tin.
Jack gets a strap and a stick.
They stamp the tin flat.
Then they fix it on the sled.
It slips fast past the big rock.

stories.title: The Smell in the Shed
lines: A bad smell was in the shed.
Bob sniffs a damp box.
Jan can lift the bin lid.
In it is a bad fish!
Bob grabs it with a rag.
He drops it in a sack.
Then Jan mops the shed.

stories.title: Mom and the Rip
lines: Jen had a rip in the flag.
Mom gets red silk and a pin.
Snip, snip, snip!
She sets the silk on the rip.
Then she can mend it.
The flag is fresh and red.
Jen hugs Mom and runs off.

stories.title: The Spell in the Red Hat
lines: Jill had a red hat.
"I can do a spell," she said.
She hits the hat with a stick.
A frog hops up!
Ben and Ted stomp and clap.
The frog jumps on Ted.
"Get it off!" he yells.
Jill picks it up and winks.

stories.title: The Drink Stand
lines: Kim and Gus set up a stand.
They sell a drink in a cup.
Kim fills the cups.
Gus tells the kids, "Stop in!"
Six kids run up fast.
A cup spills on the mat.
Gus mops it up.
At dusk they pack it up.

stories.title: The Rat in the Trap
lines: Dad set a trap in the shed.
It got a fat rat.
The rat sits and thinks.
Ted thinks it is sad.
"Let it go, Dad," he said.
Dad can lift the trap up.
The rat zips in the grass.
Ted nods and hugs Dad.

stories.title: The Bats on the Hills
lines: At dusk the bats zip past.
They swing up and land.
Kim and Nick sit on the grass.
"The bats hunt bugs," said Nick.
A bat drops past them fast.
Kim yells and ducks.
Nick claps and winks at Kim.
The hills are dim and still.
Then they run back in.

stories.title: The Crib and the Cat
lines: Meg has a big crib.
In it is a doll.
The cat hops in and naps.
Meg thinks it is fun.
She sets the doll in a tub.
Mom winks at them.
"The cat wins that spot," she said.
Meg pets the cat.
Then Meg naps on the rug.

stories.title: The Long Trip
lines: Mom and Jan plan a trip.
They pack a bag and a map.
In it are hats and socks.
Dad fills the van with gas.
They go past the hills.
Jan naps in the back.
At the pond they stop.
They swim and munch a snack.
"That was a fun trip," said Jan.

stories.title: Jan Can Skip
lines: Jan can skip fast.
She can skip up the hill.
Ben ran fast and did skid.
He fell and got a wet hand.
Jan stops and can help.
Then they skip back in.

stories.title: The Club in the Shed
lines: Sam and Fran had a club.
It met in the shed.
Ten kids went in.
They had a plan and a list.
Sam had a drum. Fran sings.
The club is fun.

stories.title: The Crop of Nuts
lines: Dad has a crop of nuts.
Tom and Kim help him pick.
They fill six bags.
A rat sits in the nuts.
It sniffs and runs off.
Dad hands Kim a big nut.

stories.title: The Print in the Mud
lines: Bess sat on the damp path.
In the mud was a print.
It was big and flat.
"That is a duck print," said Bess.
Rick thinks it is a dog.
They step past the pond.
Then a big duck hops up!

stories.title: The Best Snack
lines: Gus has a plum and a fig.
He will press them in a cup.
Kim drops in a bit of milk.
Plus a nut on top.
They mix it up.
Gus sips it. "Yum!" he said.
Kim sips it and winks.

stories.title: The Strong Box
lines: Ted had a strong box.
It was shut fast.
Jack hits it with a rock.
The lid did split!
In it are red and tan flags.
Ted hands a flag to Jack.
They run up the hill with them.

stories.title: The Frost Will Melt
lines: Frost sat on the pond.
Max steps on it.
It did not split.
Sun hits the pond at ten.
The frost will melt.
Max steps back an inch.
Drip, drip! It is a pond.
Max and Liz run in the grass.

stories.title: The Cats on the Dock
lines: Six cats sat on the dock.
Fran had a net of fish.
The cats sniff and stand up.
"Sit," said Fran. "Do not rush."
She hands a fish to a cat.
The cat can chomp it up.
The rest sit and think.
Then Fran fills the pans.

stories.title: The Thump at Dusk
lines: At dusk Ben had a thrill.
Thump! It was on the deck.
Ben and Liz stand still.
Thump, thump! It is on the steps.
Dad gets a lamp.
It is just a big dog!
It licks Ben on the hand.
They pet it and grin.

stories.title: The Bug That Can Sting
lines: A bug sat on the plum.
"It can sting," said Mom.
Jill steps back fast.
The bug zips past them.
It sits on a red flag.
Mom can shut the shed.
They sit in the sun.
The bug went off to the grass.
Jill nods and hugs Mom.

stories.title: The Dolls on the Beds
lines: Jan has six dolls.
They sit on ten beds.
Jan sings a song to them.
The cat hops up on a bed.
It naps next to a doll.
Jan pets the cat.
"You can nap with us," she said.
Mom sets a soft rag on it.
Then Jan naps with them.

stories.title: The Task
lines: Dad sent Tom on a task.
"Get a bag of nuts," he said.
Tom went past the bend.
A big dog sat on the path.
Tom kept still.
The dog left fast.
Tom got the nuts.
He ran back up the hill.
Dad hugs him. "Best task yet!"

stories.title: The Hens in the Nests
lines: Six hens sat in the nests.
Cluck, cluck! It is dusk.
Gus can shut the pen.
A fox went past it.
The hens cluck and flap.
The fox fled up the hill.

stories.title: Kim and Tim Plot a Gift
lines: Kim and Tim plot a gift.
It is a gift to Mom.
Kim gets a pink shell.
Tim gets a bit of silk.
They put them in a tin.
Mom hugs them and winks.

stories.title: The Drums and the Fans
lines: Ten drums sat on the deck.
Stan and Nell hit them.
Bang, bang, thump!
The fans clap and yell.
A dog runs up to them.
It naps on a drum.

stories.title: The Milk Tubs
lines: Dad had six tubs of milk.
He sets them in the van.
A tub fell and did spill.
Milk runs on the steps.
Tom gets a mop and a rag.
Gus can gulp a big cup.
They fill the tubs and go.

stories.title: The Plum Pit
lines: Jan bit a fresh plum.
The skin was red and thin.
She got a pit in it.
Jan spit the pit in a cup.
"Do not munch that," said Mom.
Jan nods and sips milk.
Then she gets a fig.

stories.title: Max and the Big Glass
lines: Max ran past the big glass.
He got a shock.
A kid was in it!
Max steps up and thinks.
"That is just me," he said.
He winks at himself.
Then he runs off to Mom.

stories.title: Ben Is Upset
lines: Ben was upset.
His drum fell and split.
Mom sat with him on the bed.
"Can we fix it?" he said.
Dad gets tin and a strap.
They mend the drum.
Ben hits it. Thump, thump!
Ben hugs Mom and Dad.

stories.title: The Big Jump
lines: Rick sat on a strong log.
It was up on the bank.
"Can I jump in?" he said.
Dad thinks it is a risk.
"Test it," said Dad. "Drop a rock."
Rick drops a big rock in.
Plop! It sank fast.
Then Rick jumps in with Dad.

stories.title: The Rats and the Bin
lines: Rats ran in the bin.
Gus can lift the lid.
Six rats sit on the ham.
"Get off!" he yells.
The rats fled fast.
Gus mops the bin and the mat.
He sets a lid on it.
Then the rats went to the shed.

stories.title: The Fluff on the Rug
lines: Nan has a soft cat.
Its fluff is on the rug.
Nan gets a brush.
She can brush the cat.
Fluff drops in a big lump.
The cat spins and hops.
Nan picks the fluff up.
She fills a bag with it.
Then the cat naps in the sun.

stories.title: The Shop on the Hill
lines: Gus has a shop on the hill.
He sells pots and pans.
Kim plans a gift to Mom.
She picks a red pot.
Gus hands it to Kim.
Kim gets it in a bag.
She runs up the path fast.
Mom sets the pot on the shelf.
"That is the best gift," she said.

stories.title: The Tin Tops
lines: Jan and Ben had tin tops.
Jan spun a top on the mat.
Ben spun a red top.
Smack! The tops hit and fell.
Jan picks up a bent top.
"I can lend you this," said Ben.
They spin them on the flat deck.
Meg claps from the steps.
Then they run in to lunch.

stories.title: The Stem in the Pot
lines: Nan has a pot of mud.
A thin stem is in it.
On top is a red bud.
Nan sets it in the sun.
She can pat the mud flat.
The bud gets big.

stories.title: The Slam of the Lid
lines: Ted shut the trunk.
Slam! It was a big bang.
The cat ran off fast.
Mom went up the steps.
"Do not slam it," she said.
Ted nods and pets the cat.

stories.title: The Bus Sped Past
lines: Bess ran to the bus stop.
The bus sped past.
Bess felt sad.
Dad went up in the van.
"Hop in," he said.
They sped to the shop.

stories.title: Bring the Net
lines: Jack and Jill went to the pond.
"Bring the net," said Jack.
Jill had it in a sack.
A fish went past the dock.
Jack drops the net in.
He got a fat fish!
They let it swim off.

stories.title: The Flip on the Mat
lines: Fran can do a flip.
She jumps on the soft mat.
Up she went and spun.
She got up fast.
Ten kids clap and yell.
Stan will do a flip next.
He fell, but he can grin.

stories.title: Scrub the Tub
lines: The tub had mud in it.
Mom gets a brush and a rag.
"Scrub it well," she said.
Tim can scrub the tub.
Bess mops the deck.
At dusk the tub is fresh.
Then they hop in it.

stories.title: The Strip of Silk
lines: Jen had a strip of silk.
It was pink and long.
She sets it on a stick.
It will flip in the gust.
Kids run up the hill with it.
Up it went, past the tents.
It got stuck on a twig.
Fred can lift it off.

stories.title: The Hot Run
lines: Rex the dog ran up the hill.
The sun was hot.
Rex stops and can pant.
Nick fills a pan with milk.
Rex sips it up fast.
Then he naps in the grass.
Nick pets him on the back.
"Rest a bit," he said.

stories.title: The Tusk in the Sand
lines: In the sand was a big tusk.
Bess and Glen dig it up.
It was as long as a stick.
"What is it?" said Glen.
Mom thinks it is from a pig.
They set it on a shelf.
Kids step in to check it.
Bess winks at Glen.

stories.title: A Pinch of This
lines: Mom and Liz mix a snack.
In a pot go ham and nuts.
"Just a pinch of this," said Mom.
Liz drops in a bit of fig.
They mix it up well.
Dad gets a cup and sips.
"Yum! That is fresh," he said.
Liz claps and hops.
Then they sit and munch.

stories.title: The Cat Licks Itself
lines: Max has a tan cat.
It naps on the top step.
Then it licks itself.
It rubs its chin on the rug.
Max sets a dish of milk in.
The cat sniffs it and sips.
Then it hops up on his lap.
Max pets it.
"You are a fun cat," he said.

stories.title: The Ships at the Dock
lines: Ten ships sat at the dock.
Gus and Nan step on a ship.
It is big and strong.
They lift a red flag up.
The ship went past the bank.
Fish swim next to them.
Nan yells, "A big fish!"
It jumps up and drops back in.
Gus and Nan clap and grin.

stories.title: The Wet Pup
lines: Sam has a wet pup.
It ran in the pond.
Sam gets a big rag.
He rubs the pup well.
The pup spins and hops.
Then it naps on his lap.

stories.title: The Ink Spill
lines: Jen had a pot of ink.
It fell on the desk.
Ink ran past the maps.
"Get a rag!" she yells.
Ben runs in with a mop.
They scrub the desk well.
Then Mom hands them a snack.

stories.title: The Bent Pin
lines: Kim had a bent pin.
It was stuck in the rug.
She got it up with a twig.
Mom sets it in a tin.
"That is a risk," said Mom.
Kim nods and can shut it.
They sit and mend a sock.
Then they hop up to lunch.

stories.title: The Nap in the Grass
lines: Dad and Meg sat in the grass.
The sun was hot on them.
A bug did buzz past.
Meg thinks of the pond.
"Can we swim?" she said.
Dad nods and gets the bags.
They run past the tents.
Meg jumps in fast.
Dad swam next to Meg.
